title: DelegatesComputeCommitment
description: Payload shape for a Mishpat::Commitment entry with action='delegates-compute'. The REA compute-commitment primitive instantiated for bounded authority delegation between agents. Source of truth: Holochain DHT (Mishpat zome, existing Commitment entry type — no new entry type needed; action discriminator distinguishes). Canon: genesis/docs/architecture/rea-compute-commitment-primitive.md. First concrete instance: Z.D deploy authority (genesis/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-05-25-stagespablob-substrate-correct-deploy.md).

action.description: Action discriminator. Fixed at 'delegates-compute' for this commitment kind. Other Mishpat commitments use different discriminators (project-epr, acknowledges-reach-change, etc.).

scope.description: The class of EconomicEvent the recipient is authorized to emit. Example: 'republish-epr' for Z.D deploy authority; 'serve-url-projection' for doorway hosting; 'chore-done' for household chore stewardship. See canon §5 generalization table for the full list.

provider.description: CID or agent identifier of the provider — the agent granting authority. For Z.D this is the operator's steward (e.g. agent:matthew-steward).

recipient.description: CID or agent identifier of the recipient — the agent receiving authority. For Z.D this is the per-operator deploy-service-agent.

bounds.description: Enforceable conditions the substrate validates on every EconomicEvent referencing this Commitment.

epr_scope.description: List of EPR identifiers the recipient may emit events about. Use ['*'] for an operator's bootstrap commitment that grants authority over all EPRs in the operator's scope (per canon §6 rule on first-publish authority).

reach_ceiling.description: Maximum reach value the recipient may publish at. Default and safe value is 'commons'. Reach values above commons (community, public, familiar, trusted, intimate, self, private) require reach_elevation_acknowledged=true on this Commitment — the substrate's hedge against silent reach escalation.

reach_elevation_acknowledged.description: Required true when reach_ceiling is above 'commons' or 'community'. Forces the provider-steward to explicitly acknowledge they are granting elevated authority. See canon §6 rule 3.

rate_per_hour.description: Maximum rate of in-scope EconomicEvents the recipient may emit per hour. Storage validator enforces via sliding-window query.

rotation_ttl_days.description: Key-rotation window in days. After this duration, the provider should rotate the recipient's key and re-issue the Commitment.

reciprocity.description: Optional explicit declaration of two-way obligation. Substrate uses default reciprocity if omitted (per canon §3).

provider_obligations.description: Provider's obligations to the recipient. Defaults: key-custody, soft-warn-acknowledgement, scheduled-rotation, revocation-on-compromise.

recipient_obligations.description: Recipient's obligations to the provider. Defaults: bounded-event-signing, back-reference-commitment, reach-ceiling-enforcement, rotation-compliance.

valid_from.description: ISO 8601 datetime when this Commitment becomes effective. Validated by Mishpat integrity validator to be a parseable datetime.

valid_until.description: ISO 8601 datetime when this Commitment expires. Mishpat refuses events with signed_at > valid_until.
